source_note: The 36 reviewer observations are paraphrased from the author-supplied Round 1 comment transcript in the platform attachment. The attached PDF is the manuscript draft, not the review report. A-01 through A-12 are project audit observations, not reviewer comments. No private correspondence or manuscript text is reproduced here.

status_definitions.VERIFIED_COMPLETE: The bounded technical check or artifact is verified; this does not imply editorial acceptance.
status_definitions.EXPERIMENT_COMPLETED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: The specified new or replay analysis was executed, with explicit unresolved scope limits.
status_definitions.VERIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: The retained evidence supports only the stated restricted interpretation.
status_definitions.EVIDENCE_CEILING_REACHED: The bounded search found no recoverable evidence in inspected sources; this is not a global-negative claim.
status_definitions.ACTIVE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: A concrete evidence, provenance or rights request remains actionable.
status_definitions.NEW_EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED: A study or measurement is required if the original claim is retained.
status_definitions.MANUSCRIPT_ONLY_PENDING: The technical disposition is known but the required author-approved manuscript change has not been made.
status_definitions.FULLY_ADDRESSED_BY_EVIDENCE: The original technical request is satisfied by verifiable evidence within its stated scope.
status_definitions.PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED: Some requested evidence is available, but a material part of the request remains unmet.
status_definitions.ADDRESSED_BY_SCOPE_RESTRICTION: The claim can be made accurate only by explicitly narrowing its scope; the manuscript edit is still pending.
status_definitions.NOT_SATISFIED: The requested experiment or evidence is absent and cannot be treated as resolved by wording alone.
status_definitions.EDITORIAL_ACTION_ONLY: Only author-approved text, table, figure, citation or supplement work remains.
status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE_AUDIT: This is an internal project audit item, not a peer-review comment.

items.origin: Reviewer 1, Round 1, first methodological comment
items.request: Clarify that an external-development holdout from public sources used during development is not equivalent to independent external validation; provide source-level training, validation and holdout counts or evaluate a truly independent cohort, and moderate generalizability and deployment claims.
items.manuscript_scope: Abstract, cohort description, Results, Discussion and deployment/generalizability claims.
items.protocol_population_result: Frozen transfer evaluated 25,770 SPH ECG from 24,666 source patients across P6, P8 and P4; all 14 compatible ECG-statement endpoints were scored with patient-component intervals. The source is distinct from retained evaluation sources, but complete V3F/V3AG pretraining and fine-tuning lineage is unavailable.
items.addressed_scope: A real full-source transfer analysis and endpoint-specific results now exist; this is stronger than selected development metrics alone.
items.unresolved: Historical training/source overlap is not certified, labels are not clinical adjudication, and no truly untouched validation cohort has been selected.
items.recovery_assessment: Historical source exposure can reopen only with exact job-linked training manifests. A new independent cohort is not recoverable from the current SPH evaluation.
items.experiment_requirement: A new, admissible, patient- and signal-disjoint cohort is required if independent generalization is claimed.
items.editorial_action: Distinguish selected development, SPH transfer and independent validation; remove clinical deployment claims not tested.
items.scientific_risk: High if SPH transfer is described as independent validation or clinical effectiveness.

items.origin: Reviewer 1, Round 1, second methodological comment
items.request: Report the complete clinical workflow, including primary and cascade classes, complete denominators, quarantine proportions, errors inside and outside quarantine, and predictive values under original prevalence; do not present a restricted denominator as end-to-end performance.
items.manuscript_scope: Primary denominator, Results tables, cascade and quarantine claims.
items.protocol_population_result: The later SPH source has 25,770/25,770 scores per profile and all 14 compatible endpoint comparisons. The retained selected development replay has 2,193 P8 keys, including 1,643 P6 keys, plus 733 P4 keys: a verified 2,926-key P8/P4 union, not a patient count. Routing was computed without reference labels.
items.addressed_scope: The measured all-source SPH profile coverage, empty-set/fallback counts and compatible predictive results are documented separately from selected-cohort replays.
items.unresolved: The June preselection population, exclusion reasons, complete all-class reference ontology and authentic historical quarantine policy/ledger remain unavailable. No pre/post quarantine rate can be calculated.
items.recovery_assessment: The examined backups and manifests do not recover the historical parent population. Reopen only on receipt of parent manifests, exclusion reasons and checkpoint/job-linked routing ledger.
items.experiment_requirement: A complete all-class workflow with compatible reference labels and an explicit quarantine policy is required to satisfy the original request; SPH cannot retroactively supply the missing historical flow.
items.editorial_action: Report selected denominators and measured SPH coverage; do not call either a reconstructed historical all-input workflow.
items.scientific_risk: High if restricted Primary results are described as full clinical workflow accuracy or unmeasured quarantine benefit.

items.origin: Reviewer 1, Round 1, AF-label comment
items.request: Describe how AF reference labels were created and harmonized by source, how multiple or conflicting labels were handled, and restrict language to ECG-level AF rather than incident or first-diagnosed AF without longitudinal evidence.
items.manuscript_scope: AF endpoint definition, label harmonization and Discussion terminology.
items.protocol_population_result: Stored AF flags agree with retained code 164889003 for 1,643 P6 rows and 2,193 P8 rows; each overlapping profile has 390 positive rows and zero flag mismatches or unresolved code rows. P6 is nested within P8, so counts must not be added. A co-occurring normal-rhythm code was retained, not adjudicated.
items.addressed_scope: The archived fields are internally consistent for the selected rows and the available contract supports ECG-record wording.
items.unresolved: The audit does not establish independent clinical adjudication for every source, onset, first diagnosis, incidence or patient-level longitudinal truth.
items.recovery_assessment: The current row-level code check is complete within its scope; incident AF cannot be recovered without longitudinal patient data and an appropriate reference.
items.experiment_requirement: Longitudinal AF claims require a new study; no such study is needed if the claim is confined to ECG-level statements.
items.editorial_action: State AF on the ECG, describe source-specific reference limitations and remove incident/first-diagnosed terminology unless authors supply longitudinal evidence.
items.scientific_risk: High for incidence or prognosis claims; moderate for pooled ECG statement classification because annotation policies differ.

items.origin: Reviewer 1, Round 1, cryptographic hashes comment
items.request: Replace the empty-file and placeholder values in A10 with checksums for actual archived artifacts and provide an accessible verification route; otherwise remove unsupported cryptographic reproducibility claims.
items.manuscript_scope: Appendix Table A10, artifact availability and reproducibility claims.
items.protocol_population_result: The submitted A10 contained one empty-file SHA-256 and four patterned example values. Five physical V3F/V3AG and specialist checkpoints have measured hashes, sizes and a release manifest in PR #4; Optuna DB and generic prediction artifact were not certified as recovered.
items.addressed_scope: Actual model checkpoint identities are verifiable from the public release and separate correction evidence.
items.unresolved: The original Optuna database and generic prediction file are not located; the corrected artifact list is not a one-to-one substitute for every original A10 row.
items.recovery_assessment: Bounded local/CEDIA/release checks found no verified copies of the two missing generic artifacts; a new authenticated backup listing could reopen this.
items.experiment_requirement: No model experiment is needed for the five checkpoint hashes; do not fabricate hashes for missing files.
items.editorial_action: Replace A10 with the verified artifact inventory and explicitly remove claims for unavailable artifacts; preserve the submitted PDF unchanged.
items.scientific_risk: High if unverified artifacts remain represented as hashed or reproducible.

items.origin: Reviewer 2, Round 1, general class-scope comment
items.request: Represent excluded rhythm and pathology classes as Other arrhythmia/Other pathologies, or otherwise report them so excluded classes and NSR are not hidden from realistic performance assessment.
items.manuscript_scope: Class ontology, primary and cascade heads, Methods and full-population results.
items.protocol_population_result: The published architecture declares 14 rhythm and 7 pathology outputs; P8 includes NSR and PAC. SPH measured all profile predictions on 25,770 ECG, but only 14 endpoints have compatible statement references. P8 produced 16,700 NSR top-1 outputs; no validated Other output exists.
items.addressed_scope: All-input profile decisions and the limits of declared auxiliary outputs are now visible; missing scores and incompatible labels are not converted to negatives.
items.unresolved: No validated Other class, complete ontology, class-level labels for all inputs, or evaluated primary-to-cascade performance is available.
items.recovery_assessment: The old outputs cannot establish the requested Other-class performance. A new dataset/reference mapping and model or routing evaluation would be needed.
items.experiment_requirement: Required if the original all-class performance request is retained; not satisfied by narrowing text alone.
items.editorial_action: Describe only evaluated primary endpoints and explicitly state that Other/cascade performance is not validated.
items.scientific_risk: Very high if all-input or Other performance is implied from class declarations or fallback counts.

items.addressed_scope: The non-equivalence risk is recognized; no replacement systematic or balanced literature table is yet verified.
items.unresolved: A defensible study-selection rule, broader sources and comparable task definitions are needed if the table remains.
items.recovery_assessment: Editorial literature work is feasible; it should not be replaced by selecting only favorable studies.
items.experiment_requirement: No model experiment; any quantitative comparison must use compatible published endpoints and disclose differences.
items.editorial_action: Remove the Life-only selection or define a transparent, reproducible comparator scope and revise the caption.
